entries.9911ea77b41f6e7f: This business operates “CaSy,” a matching platform that links individuals and households needing housework support services with service staff called “casts.” From request to payment, everything is completed through the smartphone app or service website. The company operates it together with two consolidated subsidiaries, Sukkiri Meister Co., Ltd. and Sanju Co., Ltd., covering 10 metropolitan and prefectural areas. It also undertakes municipal housework and childcare support programs on consignment and provides “MoNiCa,” a business management system for housework support providers.

entries.ef8c73b9ffd0c7b8: Founded in 2014, CaSy is an operator of a matching platform for household support services, with its head office in Shinagawa-ku, Tokyo. The company and its 2 consolidated subsidiaries form the group, and it has 74 employees (as of November 30, 2025).
entries.f198ef48150da071: On the technology side, it seeks to maximize matching opportunities through measures such as considering compatibility using accumulated matching data and dynamic pricing that varies cast remuneration when matching is difficult. On the hospitality side, it works to raise cast engagement through measures such as establishing “Cast Credo,” a code of conduct for casts, providing opportunities for communication among casts and a commendation system, and replying to service reports with messages from all employees.
